dialogs.about: 딸과 카페에 앉아 음료를 고르며 이야기

lines.en: Mom, what will you drink today?
I want warm tea. Coffee is too strong.
lines.ko: 따뜻한 차를 마시고 싶어요. 커피는 너무 진해요.

lines.en: They have decaf coffee here too.
Oh, then I will try the decaf.
Do you want a regular size or a large one?
lines.ko: 보통 크기로 할까요, 큰 걸로 할까요?

lines.en: Regular, please. With no ice, thank you.
lines.ko: 보통 크기로 주세요. 얼음은 빼고요, 고마워요.

lines.en: I will order at the counter now.
Do they give a sticker for takeout?
Yes, and they gave me a free refill yesterday.
lines.ko: 네, 어제는 리필도 공짜로 해 줬어요.

lines.en: How nice. Let's sit by the window.
Hello. What can I get for you?
One medium coffee, please. Is it hot?
lines.ko: 중간 크기 커피 하나 주세요. 뜨거운가요?

lines.en: Yes, very hot. Do you want ice in it?
lines.ko: 네, 아주 뜨거워요. 얼음을 넣어 드릴까요?

lines.en: No ice, thank you. Is takeout cheaper?
lines.ko: 얼음은 빼 주세요, 고마워요. 포장이 더 싼가요?

lines.en: It is the same price here.
Then I will drink it at the table.
Here is your cup. Please be careful, it is hot.
Thank you. I came here last Sunday too.
I remember. Take this sticker for a free refill.
How kind of you. I will come again.
